evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and alters wallet rescan execution logic in src/wallet/scan.cpp with a new `-walletpar` configuration option.
rationale: Parallelizing compact block filter checks during fast rescans provides a 4.5x to nearly 8x speedup on multi-core systems, addressing the wallet category focus on slow rescans. Benchmarks confirmed by multiple reviewers show rescan times dropping from over 270 seconds to under 35–63 seconds.
